What changed:
- Added `groupby` to command parsing and usage text in [SliceApplication.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-08.NqlBin/project/src/Slice/SliceApplication.cs#L5).
- Added grouped aggregation support in [CsvColumnSelector.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-08.NqlBin/project/src/Slice/CsvColumnSelector.cs#L361):
  - `groupby <column> count`
  - `groupby <column> sum <column>`
  - preserves first-seen group order
  - errors when any referenced column is missing
  - errors when `sum` sees a non-numeric value
  - emits data rows only, with no header row
  - formats summed decimals canonically, so `10.00` prints as `10`
- Added focused tests for success and failure cases in [SliceApplicationTests.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-08.NqlBin/project/tests/Slice.Tests/SliceApplicationTests.cs#L283).
